snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Variety Pack: Vol. 2
snippet.description:
Introducing the Variety Pack: Vol. 2 - bringing you four new puzzles featuring cultural heritage objects from India, England, Nepal, and Poland for 4.99$! 

Available to purchase TOMORROW in-app and through the Quest / PS VR stores! https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3931148300302917/

This DLC Puzzle Pack includes:
- Taleju Temple Door (Kathmandu, Nepal)
- Ambrose Dudley's Tomb (Warwick, England, UK)
- Banjara Costume (Hampi, India)
- Gothic Chalice (Miechów Monastery, Poland)

Special thanks to RiVR, Dystopia, and Malopolska's Virtual Museums for providing photogrammetry scans. Detailed information about each puzzle: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/varietypackvol2/
